dossiers.title: Summer Founders Program — Y Combinator (2005)
dossiers.highlight: Selected Cohort #1 (Summer 2005, 8 Startups): Loopt — Sam Altman (age 19, Stanford CS sophomore) & Nick Sivo. Mobile location sharing architecture.

dossiers.title: Introducing OpenAI (Dec 11, 2015)
dossiers.highlight: Our goal is to advance digital intelligence in the way that is most likely to benefit humanity as a whole, unconstrained by a need to generate financial return.

dossiers.title: OpenAI announces leadership transition (Nov 17, 2023)
dossiers.highlight: Mr. Altman’s departure follows a deliberative review process by the board, which concluded that he was not consistently candid in his communications with the board, hindering its ability to exercise its responsibilities.

dossiers.title: Ilya Sutskever (@ilyasut) — Regret Statement
dossiers.source_label: x.com/ilyasut — Verified Statement by Co-Founder & Chief Scientist
dossiers.highlight: “I deeply regret my participation in the board's actions. I never intended to harm OpenAI. I love everything we've built together and I will do everything I can to reunite the company.”

dossiers.title: Open Letter of 730+ Employees to OpenAI Board
dossiers.source_label: Open Letter to the Board of Directors at OpenAI
dossiers.highlight: We are unable to work for or with people that lack competence, judgement and care for our mission and employees. OpenAI is nothing without its people.
